data_snapshot: Bitemporal range: valid-time range selected by the user (period or dates) and known-at = generation time, or a chosen past known-at for 'as reported on <date>' views; both times printed; restated rows marked.
versioning_reissue: Versioned by definition version + snapshot/watermark; each generation is a new artifact with its own id; regenerating with the same snapshot and versions must produce identical per-page text (determinism check). Definition changes create a new report definition version and mark restated history.
access_control: Sponsor communications and compliance roles. Authorization re-checked at open and download, not only at listing; short-lived scoped download tokens; no public links (REQ-X-035)
distribution: Staff report viewer and scheduled delivery to named roles inside the platform; exports (CSV/JSON/PDF) need export permission, are logged and carry metric version and snapshot/watermark
accessible_html: Accessible HTML rendition generated from the same snapshot and integrity reference (UNB-RCN-PLT-010, RCD-009): semantic headings, table captions and th scope, money as text with tabular numerals, no information in colour alone, reading order equals print order; axe-core 0 violations (wcag2a..wcag22aa) at 320 and 1280 px; opened from the Document Center (UNB-UI-S-007) or report viewer.
pdf: Letter PDF rendered by the Folio P2 contract with Chromium tagged:true and outline:true; tagged PDF validated against PDF/UA-1 with veraPDF or PAC (FOLIO-GAP-11 open: until validated, the HTML twin is the accessible rendition and the PDF states so); /Lang set; 'Page n of N' (FOLIO-GAP-04), running reference, verification code and legal-sponsor disclosure on every page (FOLIO-GAP-05), identifiers and URLs unbroken in text extraction (FOLIO-GAP-06), multi-page table headers repeat and grand totals print once (FOLIO-GAP-08); determinism = per-page pdftotext SHA-256 stable across renders.
retention_class: Audit and control evidence class: at least 7 years (REQ-X-036 floor) or engagement/regulatory period if longer; legal holds override
generator: Folio 0.4.2 elements (vendored, design review only) composed by the Unbound render service; Unbound computes all figures (Folio never computes metrics): ef-print-document; ef-print-header (repeat=page; FOLIO-GAP-05); ef-print-footer (repeat=page; FOLIO-GAP-05); ef-print-page-number (FOLIO-GAP-04); ef-print-section; ef-print-table (FOLIO-GAP-08 for totals); ef-print-integrity; ef-print-keep; .ef-dense recipe (FOLIO-GAP-09 workaround)

acceptance_criteria.given: accepted-only messages
acceptance_criteria.then: status reads 'Accepted by provider'

acceptance_criteria.given: the report rendered twice from the same snapshot and versions
acceptance_criteria.then: per-page text SHA-256 values are identical and the reference and verification code extract intact on every page

acceptance_criteria.given: the accessible HTML rendition
acceptance_criteria.when: axe-core (wcag2a..wcag22aa) runs and a screen reader user navigates by headings and tables
acceptance_criteria.then: 0 violations; every table has a caption and header cells; the same snapshot id appears as in the PDF

acceptance_criteria.given: a user outside the access rule
acceptance_criteria.when: they request the report or its download link
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is identical to not-found and the attempt is logged
